The Everyday Abilities Review Checklist

What to write down, gather and ask about while Dad is managing well.

Download PDF

Dad still does most things himself, and nothing on this page assumes otherwise. It lists what to put on paper now, so the family has a dated starting point to compare against later. Check what you've done. Anything unchecked is simply not written down yet. It says nothing about Dad.

Write down

Gather

Ask

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you write down, gather and ask. It doesn't say what any of it means, whether anything has changed, or when Dad should be looked at again. Those belong to the professionals who know him, and to the next step below.

Ready for the next step?

You've checked what's written down, what's gathered and what's been asked. The care interview takes it from there: it goes through Dad's everyday life area by area, including the parts a one-page list leaves out, and turns your answers into a Family Care Profile you can bring to any care conversation.
